name: review
what: One fresh checker's report on one revision: the exact prompt, the commit, its paraphrase, its findings and their answers.

fields.name: round, lens, commit
fields.means: which round, which lens, which revision

fields.name: prompt
fields.means: the exact prompt the checker got

fields.name: findings
fields.means: severity (Blocker, Major, Nit), where, finding, answer (fix, contest, escalate, decline), note

written_by: a fresh checker; the answers by the orchestrator

trace.step: 2 · Specify, or 3 · Build at a checkpoint
trace.author: agent
trace.note: A fresh checker's findings; the worker's answers are added in the event that answers them.
trace.reflection: Every new one says what it supersedes or merges among the ones of its type that hold; every change to it is an event of an AIP in the same commit (d-f960).
